paragraphs.text: The Sea King is a deity worshipped in Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

The Sea King's real name (if any) is unknown, but he is represented as an elderly king with a noble bearing, a long beard, and a prominent crown. He is the god of the Sea of Serenity , the sea that lies south of Jamuraa . His name was invoked by Johan before the Battle of Palmyra , and his aid was beseeched by Hazezon Tamar in a ritual of Visions .
